items.title: GlobalFoundries: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: GlobalFoundries reported record gross margins of 31.4% in Q3 2026, driven by a strategic shift away from lower-margin mobile devices toward high-growth optical networking and automotive silicon. The company expects silicon photonics revenue to hit $1 billion annualized run rate by end of 2027 (one year ahead of schedule) and plans to triple capacity in this segment. Notably, GFS is funding expansion through customer prepayments and government grants rather than heavy upfront capital spending, with planned 2027 net capex of approximately $4 billion. Over two-thirds of Q3 revenue now comes from non-mobile applications, demonstrating successful diversification.
